quizName: Hardest Questions in Michigan Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Why are signals important on a motorcycle?

options.text: They serve little purpose since motorcycles are smaller than other vehicles.
They alert other drivers to your plans to turn or change lanes.
You should only use them if other vehicles are close by.
They are more difficult to use than signals on a car.

questions.correctAnswerText: They alert other drivers to your plans to turn or change lanes.
questions.explanation: As a motorcycle rider, you are more vulnerable. Always use your turn signals when you plan to turn or change lanes. Use them even if you think no one is near you.

questions.question: When should you check your mirrors?

options.text: Check them regularly as part of your normal scanning routine.
Avoid them because they will distract you.
Avoid them because other drivers can see you easily.
Check them only in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check them regularly as part of your normal scanning routine.
questions.explanation: For your safety, check your mirrors often. Knowing what is behind you is very important for safe riding.

questions.question: What can remove alcohol from your body?

options.text: Time
Coffee
Exercise
Fresh air

questions.correctAnswerText: Time
questions.explanation: Only waiting lowers your blood alcohol level. Coffee, exercise, fresh air, and cold showers cannot reduce how much alcohol is in your body or make you sober. They may keep you awake, but they do not change your blood alcohol level.

questions.question: What clothing should you wear on a motorcycle?

options.text: Clothes that cover your arms and legs completely.
Clothes that cover your arms but leave your legs exposed.
Clothes that cover your legs but leave your arms exposed.
Whatever is most comfortable, even if it is not safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Clothes that cover your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: Wear a jacket and pants that fully cover your arms and legs to protect yourself.

questions.question: How do you know if a motorcycle is the right size for you?

options.text: You can touch the ground with your feet while sitting on it.
You can reach the controls by stretching.
The handlebars are above your head.
Your feet cannot rest on the foot pegs.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can touch the ground with your feet while sitting on it.
questions.explanation: A good fit means your feet can touch the ground when you sit on the motorcycle. You should be able to easily reach and use all the controls.

questions.question: How should you check your tire pressure?

options.text: Look at the tire to see if it looks right.
Use a tire gauge.
Squeeze the tire with your hand.
Compare the height of your tire to another tire.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use a tire gauge.
questions.explanation: Use a tire gauge before every ride. A tire that is not full of air may still look okay, so looking at it is not enough.

questions.question: What is a benefit of wearing a DOT-approved helmet?

options.text: It reduces your side vision.
It greatly reduces the risk of serious head injury.
It is usually uncomfortable.
It makes it harder to control the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: It greatly reduces the risk of serious head injury.
questions.explanation: A helmet greatly improves your chances of avoiding serious head or neck injury in a crash. A DOT-approved helmet does not reduce your side vision.

questions.question: What type of boots or shoes should you wear while riding?

options.text: Boots made of soft material.
Boots with long laces that hang loose.
Boots that cover your ankle and provide support.
Boots with tall heels.

questions.correctAnswerText: Boots that cover your ankle and provide support.
questions.explanation: Wear sturdy boots that cover and support your ankles. Use low heels so they do not catch on anything. Tuck in long laces so they do not get caught in the motorcycle.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel tired while riding?

options.text: Keep riding and hope you wake up.
Ride faster.
Ride on the shoulder of the road.
Leave the road and rest.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave the road and rest.
questions.explanation: Do not ride when you are tired. On long trips, rest every two hours to avoid fatigue.

questions.question: How does your body remove alcohol?

options.text: Time.
Drinking coffee.
Exercising.
Taking a cold shower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Time.
questions.explanation: Only time removes alcohol from your body. There are no shortcuts to becoming sober.

questions.question: What should you do to reduce your chances of having an accident?

options.text: Try to blend in with traffic so other drivers don't notice you.
Don't use turn signals unless you are riding at night.
Use your turn signals when changing lanes and making turns.
Ride very close to the vehicle in front of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your turn signals when changing lanes and making turns.
questions.explanation: To reduce crash risk, make sure other drivers can see you. Use your turn signals, brake lights, and lane position to show your intentions. Keep enough space between you and other vehicles. Look ahead 12 seconds. Be ready to react if danger appears.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT need to be checked regularly?

options.text: The brakes
The bolts and fasteners
The tires
The paint

questions.correctAnswerText: The paint
questions.explanation: Before every ride, check your tires, controls, chain, sprockets, shock absorbers, bolts, and brakes. A small problem on a motorcycle can be very dangerous in traffic.

questions.question: What is the single most important thing you can do to survive a crash?

options.text: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.
Wear shorts.
Wear sneakers.
Wear goggles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.
questions.explanation: Wearing a good helmet that is fastened securely is the single best thing you can do to improve your chances of surviving a crash.

questions.question: If you cannot avoid a slippery surface, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up and lean the motorcycle.
Speed up and keep the motorcycle upright.
Slow down and lean the motorcycle.
Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright.
questions.explanation: If you cannot avoid a slippery surface, keep your motorcycle upright and go over it as slowly as possible.

questions.question: What is the best source of information about your motorcycle?

options.text: The owner's manual.
A general book about motorcycles.
Someone who rides a different type of motorcycle.
A television show about motorcycle riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: The owner's manual.
questions.explanation: Read the owner's manual before riding your motorcycle for the first time. This is especially important if you are riding a borrowed motorcycle. This will help you learn about your specific motorcycle.

questions.question: Motorcycle riders should wear shoes with soles that are:

options.text: Hard, durable, and slip-resistant.
Breathable to let air through.
Have tall heels.
Soft and flimsy.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hard, durable, and slip-resistant.
questions.explanation: Choose riding boots or shoes that are high and sturdy enough to cover and support your ankles. Pick footwear with soles made of hard, durable, slip-resistant material.

questions.question: Mirror checks should:

options.text: Not be done because they are not important.
Only be done on long trips.
Be part of your regular scanning routine.
Not be done because you can't do anything about what is behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be part of your regular scanning routine.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often as part of your normal routine. Also check mirrors before changing lanes, before stopping at intersections, and before slowing down.

questions.question: Riding gloves should:

options.text: Not be worn because they make your hands too hot.
Be worn to give you a better grip on the handgrips.
Not be worn because they make it hard to use the controls.
Only be worn on cool days.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be worn to give you a better grip on the handgrips.
questions.explanation: Wear gloves made of leather or other durable material when riding. They improve your grip on the handgrips and help protect your hands if you crash.

questions.question: For the best protection, wear a helmet that:

options.text: Fits snugly.
Is well-worn and broken in.
Is loose.
Does not have a chinstrap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fits snugly.
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards. It should fit snugly all the way around and have no obvious damage.

questions.question: Which type of footwear is best for a motorcycle operator?

options.text: Sturdy boots
Tennis shoes
Shoes with loose laces
Sandals

questions.correctAnswerText: Sturdy boots
questions.explanation: Sturdy boots or shoes that are high enough to support your ankles provide the best protection. Laced-up boots are best, but high-top boots or heavy shoes work well. If you wear shoes with long laces, tuck them in securely before riding.
